index_line: - [[focal-sopra-n1]] — 8 Ω, beryllium top-line standmount, LW ~±1.4 dB (NRC), sens 87.8 dB, f6 ~50 Hz, $12,998 (Audioholics/NRC)
source_index_lines: - [[mfr-focal-sopra-n1]] — Focal specs via TMR Audio (Tier C)
brand_notes: Sopra is Focal's top standmount line below Utopia; N°1 uses beryllium IHL tweeter, 'W' cone, 19 kg cabinet; US price rose from $9,990 (2020, soundstage-focal-sopra-n1) to $12,998 listed at TMR (mfr-focal-sopra-n1). Focal's specs run optimistic: claimed 89 dB / 41 Hz vs measured 86.8-87.8 dB / ~50 Hz. spinorama dataset 'Focal Sopra 1' is this same speaker. Focal.com product URLs 404 to scripted fetch.
takeaways: Two Tier-A sets (Audioholics, NRC) agree on a flat, neutral response; sensitivity 86.8-87.8 dB vs 89 claimed.
Bass extension nearer 50 Hz (-6 dB) than Focal's 41 Hz claim.
Impedance: Audioholics ~5 Ω min vs NRC graph ~3.8 Ω; flag below-iec per Audioholics.
THD+N ~1.3% at 100 Hz at ~96 dB/1 m (NRC graph-read), clean above 200 Hz.
Critics (Audioholics, SoundStage) praise midrange, treble, imaging; only bass output for price criticised.
Price $12,998/pair at TMR (assumed pair) vs $9,990 in 2020.
conflicts: min impedance ~5 Ω (Audioholics) vs ~3.8 Ω (NRC graph)
f6 ~50 Hz measured vs 41 Hz claimed
